The 17th and 18th Century

hint.sound: <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>denomination</lang> bedeutet Konfession. <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>persecution</lang> bedeutet Verfolgung.
hint.label: Vocabulary

atoms.text: In 1607, the first English settlers arrived in North America, fleeing England due to the persecution of Puritans—a Protestant denomination. Other Europeans followed, settling along the North Atlantic coast. Many of them also sought religious freedom in the colonies.
atoms.sound: In 1607, the first English settlers arrived in North America, fleeing England due to persecution of their Puritan faith—a Protestant denomination. Other Europeans followed, settling along the North Atlantic coast. Many of them also sought religious freedom in the colonies.

atoms.a: Where did the first Europeans arrive?

hint.sound: <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>denomination</lang> bedeutet Konfession. <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>persecution</lang> bedeutet Verfolgung.
hint.label: Vocabulary

b: ++The first English settlers were Protestant refugees.
American settlements were populated by only English-speaking colonists.

atoms.text: In the South, many Spanish traders, and settlers largely Catholic had already established colonies by the end of the 16th century. Together these European colonists established trading posts, settlements and plantations and were part of Europe’s wider colonial expansion to the Americas.

b: Spanish traders refused to trade with English settlers.

hint.sound: <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>treaty</lang> bedeutet Abkommen. <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>peoples</lang> bedeutet Völker. <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>people</lang> bedeutet Volk oder Menschen.
hint.label: Vocabulary

atoms.text: In the 17th and 18th centuries, Indigenous Americans lived independently from Europeans. They chose to trade with the colonists and made treaties with them. The European settlers often relied on Indigenous knowledge and support. Alliances between Indigenous peoples and European colonists were central during the French and Indian War (1754-1763).

hint.sound: <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>treaty</lang> bedeutet Abkommen. <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>peoples</lang> bedeutet Völker. <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>people</lang> bedeutet Volk oder Menschen.

b: Indigenous Americans were powerless against the white settlers.
++Indigenous Americans were important allies during the French and Indian War.

instruction.text: When did the French and Indian War take place?

atoms.text: When European colonists began to settle further inland, Indigenous Americans became an obstacle for them. Growing expansion, stolen land, missionary stations, disease, and recurring violence strained the relationship and harmed Indigenous people.

atoms.a: Indigenous people were negatively affected by …

atoms.b: European settlement started by the end of the ((16th)) century with Spanish settlers.
The first English settlers were ((Puritans)) who arrived in ((1607)).
Indigenous Americans engaged in ((trade_and_diplomacy)) with European colonists.
As European settlement continued, violence and displacement of Indigenous Americans ((increased)).
